rv.q: With its infectious score and sharp humour, this production is one that understands exactly what makes this musical so enduring.
The cult horror-comedy musical is back at Manchester's Hope Mill Theatre, and it's an absolute blast.

cn.t: This cult horror-comedy musical delights critics with its bloodthirsty plant star and gloriously sadistic performances, particularly Benjamin Yates as the dentist, delivering a darkly comic blast that has audiences grinning throughout.
